         5                  THE PRESIDENT:    Senator Larkin.

         6                  SENATOR LARKIN:    Thank you, Madam

         8                  You know, next week is Hospital

         9       Veterans Week across America.  And while we're

        10       celebrating and saluting the veterans, this is

        11       an appropriate time that we remember this

        12       celebration is to show our support to the men

        13       and women who have served this country with

        14       honor, defending our freedom, and to remind us

        15       to continue our support for our current

        16       soldiers doing their duty with honor while in

        17       harm's way.

        18                  The American Veterans

        19       Administration and military hospitals are

        20       caring for a large number of war wounded, and

        21       they're doing an outstanding job.  And I

        22       believe that we owe it to them to honor them

        23       in this week of National Veterans Hospital

        24       Week.

        17                  SENATOR MEIER:    Thank you, Madam

        18       President, to explain my vote.

        19                  This is one of the positive

        20       measures that we were talking about yesterday.

        21       And what this bill acknowledges is a

        22       shortcoming in the registry, the statewide

        23       registry on orders of protection.  It is an

        24       acknowledgment that domestic violence and the

        25       abuse of children often go hand in hand and


                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       are found within the same dysfunctional

         2       families and the same households.

         3                  What this does is it fixes a

         4       glaring error in that registry.  It requires

         5       that orders of protection issued with regard

         6       to child abuse and neglect proceedings be put

         7       forth in the registry so that they're there

         8       with the protection orders for DV cases.

         9                  That is a valuable tool for judges,

        10       for child protective service workers, and part

        11       of much more that you're going to be seeing as

        12       we work our way through this system to protect

        13       children.  I vote aye.

        14                  Thank you, Madam President.
